name: Sec
how_to_use_markdown:
Sec r eturns current seconds as an integer

![Example](./images/img-1631796674.png)

The above condition is checking whether the current seconds is greater than 30, suppose if the time is 11:45:32, the condition will be true.

Please note, the range is 1 - 59
